+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+
+BOOTSTRAP = r"""
+import importlib
+import importlib.abc
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+import types
+
+sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
+both = sys.argv[2] == "both"
+
+def fast_pipe(*args):
+    return args
+
+def slow_pipe(*args):
+    return args
+
+def forbidden_merge(*args):
+    raise AssertionError("bootstrap must not call toolz.merge")
+
+class FixtureLoader(importlib.abc.Loader):
+    def create_module(self, spec):
+        return None
+
+    def exec_module(self, module):
+        backend, _, child = module.__name__.partition(".")
+        module.__package__ = backend
+        module.__file__ = module.__name__ + ".py"
+        module.__doc__ = module.__name__ + " documentation"
+        module.choice = object()
+        module.payload = []
+        module.pipe = fast_pipe if backend == "cytoolz" else slow_pipe
+        if not child:
+            module.__path__ = []
+            if backend == "toolz":
+                module.merge = forbidden_merge
+            module.audit = importlib.import_module(backend + ".audit")
+
+class FixtureFinder(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
+    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
+        backend, _, child = fullname.partition(".")
+        if backend not in {"cytoolz", "toolz"}:
+            return None
+        if (backend == "toolz" and not both) or child not in {"", "audit"}:
+            raise ModuleNotFoundError("no fixture: " + fullname, name=fullname)
+        return importlib.util.spec_from_loader(
+            fullname, FixtureLoader(), is_package=not child
+        )
+
+sys.meta_path.insert(0, FixtureFinder())
+import tlz
+from tlz import _build_tlz as builder
+
+fast = sys.modules["cytoolz"]
+slow = sys.modules["toolz"] if both else fast
+assert tlz.__name__ == "tlz"
+assert tlz.__package__ == "tlz"
+assert tlz.__doc__.startswith("``tlz`` mirrors")
+assert tlz.__file__ == slow.__file__
+assert tlz.choice is fast.choice
+assert tlz.payload is fast.payload
+assert tlz.pipe is slow.pipe
+assert tlz._build_tlz is sys.modules["tlz._build_tlz"]
+assert tlz.audit is sys.modules["tlz.audit"]
+assert tlz.audit is not fast.audit
+assert importlib.import_module("tlz.audit") is tlz.audit
+assert tlz.audit.__name__ == "tlz.audit"
+assert tlz.audit.__package__ == "tlz"
+assert tlz.audit.__doc__ == fast.audit.__doc__
+assert tlz.audit.__file__ == slow.audit.__file__
+assert tlz.audit.choice is fast.audit.choice
+assert tlz.audit.payload is fast.audit.payload
+assert tlz.audit.pipe is slow.audit.pipe
+
+loader = builder.TlzLoader()
+target = types.ModuleType("tlz.audit", "caller documentation")
+chosen = target.choice = object()
+target.__file__ = "caller.py"
+loader.exec_module(target)
+assert target.__name__ == "tlz.audit"
+assert target.choice is chosen
+assert target.__doc__ == "caller documentation"
+assert target.__file__ == slow.audit.__file__
+assert target.pipe is slow.audit.pipe
+
+attempts = []
+replacement = types.ModuleType("toolz.policy")
+def dependency_failure(name):
+    attempts.append(name)
+    if name.startswith("cytoolz"):
+        raise ModuleNotFoundError("nested dependency", name="unrelated_dependency")
+    return replacement
+builder.import_module = dependency_failure
+assert loader._load_toolz("tlz.policy") == {"toolz": replacement}
+assert attempts == ["cytoolz.policy", "toolz.policy"]
+
+attempts.clear()
+def initialization_failure(name):
+    attempts.append(name)
+    raise ImportError("initialization failed")
+builder.import_module = initialization_failure
+try:
+    loader._load_toolz("tlz.policy")
+except ImportError as error:
+    assert error.args == ("tlz.policy",)
+else:
+    raise AssertionError("both failures must raise ImportError")
+assert attempts == ["cytoolz.policy", "toolz.policy"]
+"""
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("environment", ["cytoolz_only", "both"])
+def test_tlz_bootstrap_without_merge_dependency(environment):
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-I", "-c", BOOTSTRAP, str(root), environment],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr

spec.question:
Support importing `tlz` in a cytoolz-only installation. In the isolated environment we need to support, every import of `toolz` or one of its submodules raises `ModuleNotFoundError` with `name` equal to the requested module, while `cytoolz` and its corresponding child modules import successfully. Loading `tlz/__init__.py` must complete, and mirrored children must also be importable.

Update `tlz/_build_tlz.py` so bootstrap, loader construction, and namespace population work without an installed `toolz`. Namespace population must no longer call `toolz.merge`, even when both backends are installed. Preserve the existing target-wins namespace merge, fast-backend preference, owned-child mirroring, documentation handling, and slow-backend `__file__` selection. Retain the existing exceptions to target-wins behavior for owned-child replacement and the mandatory `toolz.pipe` identity override when toolz is available. Without toolz, use the cytoolz exports without requiring that override. Existing toolz-only behavior must continue to work.

Leave `_load_toolz`'s current exception and fallback policy unchanged. Deliver a unified diff against the production files only; do not modify tests.
